name: investigate
invariants: The investigation never edits code: no node writes, creates, or deletes a file in the repository, changes the index, or moves a branch; scratch scripts, logs, the report, and drafts live outside the working tree.

Code is read at the remote base branch: baseline fetches origin and, when the local checkout is behind origin/<base>, reads files with git show origin/<base>:<path> instead of the working tree; the report names the commit it read.

A cause is not reported without reproduction or explicit equivalent evidence (logs, data, or a falsifiable hypothesis with a safe observation plan); otherwise the run ends at user_decision with what a person must provide.
Writes to external systems (issue comments, tracker transitions, chat messages) are drafts saved next to the report; a person posts them.
A needed code fix is handed to fix-bug with the report path; fix-bug then starts from its brief instead of repeating triage and reproduce.
